comparison_model_opened_only_now: Classical oriented Euclidean plane over the standard real scalar field, used strictly as a comparison model rather than a source of starting primitives.

scalar_relation.R4_RAW_ISOPERIMETRIC_CUT: J=4π; J/4=π in the comparison model

identifications.comparison_interpretation: Identify oriented directions with the standard angular quotient R/(2π Z) and unoriented directions by additionally identifying θ with θ+π.
identifications.symbolic_identification: delta_q([θ])=[θ+π]. Thus the frozen deck role is the standard half-turn class π mod 2π.

identifications.comparison_interpretation: Interpret the S4 realization of the unique group involution as vector negation on oriented directions.
identifications.symbolic_identification: By frozen A* coherence, R3=R2, hence its standard angular class is also π mod 2π.

identifications.backpropagation: NONE; the regular realization is not added to S1.
identifications.comparison_interpretation: Under an explicitly extra comparison-only equivariant realization of an even cyclic boundary as a regular Euclidean polygon, successor advances by 2π/m.
identifications.symbolic_identification: The frozen half-cycle s^(m/2) advances by (m/2)(2π/m)=π.

identifications.backpropagation: NONE; neither the normalization nor Euclidean area is inserted into S5.
identifications.comparison_interpretation: Interpret N as standard Euclidean length and mu as standard Euclidean area, but only in this Stage-F comparison.
identifications.symbolic_identification: The classical isoperimetric inequality gives Per(C)^2 >= 4π Area(C); regular polygon refinement approaches the sharp bound, so the frozen raw polygonal infimum J equals 4π. The comparison readout J/4 therefore identifies with π.

identifications.backpropagation: NONE; S6 retains no scalar angle map or chosen generator.
identifications.comparison_interpretation: In the standard additive angular cover, restrict to the preimage of the subgroup {identity, half-turn}. This lift is π Z with kernel 2π Z over identity.
identifications.symbolic_identification: The inversion-quotient generator class of the kernel maps to the orientation-free full-turn class {+2π,-2π}.

post_comparison_mutation_policy: Any change to frozen signatures, roles, or pre-F theorem statements is NEW_GENERATION_FOR_LATER_TASK.
